notes: Rates confirmed on the City of Providence's official winter-rate announcement. Standard is the community default (auto-enrollment); Basic has no additional renewable energy; Standard adds 5% voluntary RI New renewables; 50 and 100 tiers bring total renewables to 50% / 100%. Program site: Electricity.ProvidenceRI.gov. Supplier phone on file with the city: NextEra Energy Services (888) 387-1084. Leave or switch tiers any time, no fees.

Rates confirmed on the Town of Portsmouth's official announcement, which also states the eight founding municipalities (Barrington, Central Falls, Narragansett, Newport, North Kingstown, Portsmouth, Providence, South Kingstown) all work with Good Energy and share a common electricity supplier and pricing. Portsmouth states the period as November 2026 until May 2027 meter reads (Providence states Nov-Apr; same 6-month winter period, meter-read boundary wording differs).
rate_period: November 2026 - May 2027 meter reads (6 months, per town announcement)

notes: Rates confirmed in the Town of Barrington's official press release (DocumentCenter, barrington.ri.gov): identical four-tier residential pricing to Providence and Portsmouth, effective with the November meter read. Supplier contact in the release: NextEra Energy Services (877) 200-8619; program site BarringtonCommunityElectricity.com.

Narragansett's town site names the program 'Narragansett Community Choice Electricity' and publishes the same tier structure; the individual winter-rate release for Narragansett was not fetched, but Portsmouth's official announcement confirms all eight towns share the same supplier and pricing, and Narragansett's prior-period (May-Nov 2026) town document showed pricing identical to Providence's for that period (Basic 13.287 / Standard 13.519 / 50: 13.705 / 100: 16.026). Winter figures here follow the verified group pricing.
